data.name: Brood Bond
data.description: At 14th level, your life becomes linked to your brood. This functions as the life bond ability, except you can only transfer damage to one eidolon in the brood at a time. If that eidolon takes enough damage to send it back to its home plane, all excess damage remains with you, killing you.
